name: openmbd_humanoid
citation: Tierney. OpenMBD: An Open-Source Multibody Dynamics Simulator for Biomechanics Research and Education. F1000Research, 2026.
description: Unitree H1-2 full-size humanoid robot with dexterous hands (27 actuated revolute joints; fingers locked open). Every joint holds the Unitree standing posture through its position controller (PD with the hardware torque limit) and a mechanical end stop.

metadata.name: OpenMBD Unitree H1-2 Humanoid Robot Model
metadata.description: Unitree H1-2 full-size humanoid robot with dexterous hands (27 actuated revolute joints; fingers locked open). Every joint holds the Unitree standing posture through its position controller (PD with the hardware torque limit) and a mechanical end stop.
metadata.license: GNU General Public License v3 (model file). Source robot description BSD-3-Clause, Copyright Unitree Robotics.
metadata.frames: Every body frame is parallel to the global frame in the zero pose (x forward, y left, z up) with its origin at the joint to its parent. Revolute joints rotate about T1[:3,2] (parent axes); positive is right-handed, identical to Unitree's convention.

standing_pose.note: Set the root position to (0, 0, pelvis_height_m) and enter each angle in the field of the joint's hinge axis (Y for pitch joints).

metadata.oblique_axes: left/right_shoulder_pitch_joint hinge lies at 15 deg to the torso Y axis (axis_parent). Enter an angle q as [Z, Y, X] = q * [a_z, a_y, a_x].

joint_restraints.convention: Restraints about the parent body axes, [Z, Y, X]; elastic_curve gives the moment (N m) resisting a deflection (deg) from neutral_angle; damping N m s/rad. rom_limits false: the human range-of-motion table does not apply.
joint_restraints.powered: Within the hardware range the curve is the Unitree joint position controller kp*(q - q_stand), saturated at the actuator torque limit; damping = controller kd.
joint_restraints.end_stops: Beyond the hardware range the moment rises by the torque limit over 2.0 deg and continues linearly (provisional).

metadata.contact_surfaces: 106 oriented ellipsoids optimised to the solid envelope of the Unitree CAD meshes (soft Tversky overlap, k-means initialisation). Mass-weighted IoU 0.829, CAD volume covered 0.916. Surfaces near-rigid: linear 5 kN/mm, elastic (provisional); against human ellipsoids the series combination is governed by the human characteristic (ISO/TS 15066 Annex A).
metadata.hands: The 12 finger and thumb links of each Inspire hand are welded to the wrist_yaw_link in their zero (open) pose; their mass and inertia are included in that body.
limitations: No balance controller: the model holds its joints like the real servos but does not balance. From the standing pose it settles within ~0.1 s and starts to topple forward after ~0.5 s (as Unitree's MJCF does in MuJoCo under the same gains), so start impact events within the first 0.5 s.
Actuator torque-speed limits, rotor inertia and joint friction are not represented.
The ankle parallel linkage is represented by Unitree's equivalent serial pitch and roll joints.
The OpenMBD restraint angle is wrapped to +-180 deg, so end stops more than 180 deg from neutral are not represented.
Robot surface stiffness and end-stop stiffness are provisional.
metadata.validation: Checked against Unitree's MJCF in MuJoCo 3.16: segment CoM positions at random poses agree within 0.001 mm, system kinetic energy for random joint rates within 0.0001 %, gravity joint torques within 2e-6 N m; with the same gains and friction 0.4, the pelvis CoM trajectory from the standing pose agrees within 0.5 mm over 0.5 s and within 7 mm over 1.2 s (dt 1e-4 s; 2e-5 s gives the same result within 0.2 mm).
sources: Unitree Robotics, H1-2 description h1_2.xml and meshes, BSD-3-Clause; github.com/unitreerobotics/unitree_ros (robots/h1_2_description): segment masses, centres of mass, inertia tensors, joint locations, axes, ranges, actuator torque limits, CAD geometry
Unitree Robotics, unitree_rl_gym deploy/deploy_real/configs/h1_2.yaml: position-control gains (kp, kd) and standing joint angles used on the physical H1-2
Unitree Robotics, H1 / H1-2 product specification, unitree.com/h1: height ~1.78 m, mass ~70 kg, thigh and shank 0.40 m
ISO/TS 15066:2016 Robots and robotic devices - Collaborative robots, Annex A
